summary: Step 2 state-management features for Мультиполия PWA fully verified via Playwright. All 5 scenarios create matches with correct starting balances, human/bot turn flow works (roll animates, roll-result shows 'a + b = sum' with 'Дубль!' on doubles), doubles grant extra turn, three doubles in a row relocate player to Black Hole with proper history log, round completion triggers benefit (kap_kap +50$) and UBI (nar_nar +1 g) for every player, history modal renders all entries, language switch RU/EN/UA re-renders history text, persistence via localStorage resumes same match (turn/history length preserved), mobile 390px tabs switch board/players/history panes.
critical_code_review_comments: state.js: Match.endTurn() calls completeRound() *before* roundNo increments and dispatches change, which is correct, but note that log entry 'h.round' uses params.n = current roundNo (which is the completed one) — fine, kept for clarity.

app.js: scheduleBot uses a 900ms delay without disabling the roll button for the human; relies on phase check — acceptable for step 2 but could still race if user clicks exactly when a bot-change event occurs. Low priority.
state.js SCENARIO_RULES.kap_gos has a comment 'start sum: awaiting customer' — confirm 2000 ₽ is final value (currently tested as per spec).
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage.clear() + fresh matches per scenario; no persistent seed data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Debug hook window.MP.ui.match exposes the live Match instance; roll([a,b]) can force deterministic dice, endTurn() advances phase. localStorage key is 'mp.match'. All data-testids present and reliable. Board movement is intentionally stubbed (player stays on Istok Cosmoport unless three-doubles rule teleports to Black Hole).
